title: AIPA Governance Record to DigiEmu Case 005 Mapping Sample
purpose: Maps a minimal AIPA governance record declaration to DigiEmu Case 005 verification anchors and expected verification outcome.

boundary_model.aipa: Declares governance state, continuity mode, review status, approval context, and authority semantics.
boundary_model.digiemu_proof: Independently verifies whether the declared continuity survives deterministic anchor validation.

aipa_declaration_fields.declared_authority_context: sample reviewer approval for boundary validation
aipa_declaration_fields.declared_continuity_claim: This governance record inherits the prior policy and authority context without declared override.

intentionally_separate_fields: AIPA review/approval state remains a governance declaration, not a verification result.
DigiEmu PASS/FAIL remains independently derived, not declared by AIPA.
Fingerprints and anchors remain verification evidence, not governance claims.
AIPA can declare continuity, but DigiEmu Proof decides whether that continuity verifies.

interpretation: The AIPA governance record declares inherited continuity and approved review state. DigiEmu Proof evaluates the corresponding anchors and returns FAIL because the dependency fingerprint changes without explicit override.
